faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Each box contains 4–6 curated Japanese stationery items — pens, paper, washi tape, stickers, and more — centered around a monthly theme.
faq.a2: Shipping is a flat $10/month worldwide, included in your $60 total. No surprises at checkout.
faq.q3: Do I have to pay customs duties?
faq.a3: Shipments are sent DDU (Delivered Duty Unpaid). Depending on your country, you may be responsible for import duties and taxes. Most small packages under $50 value clear without charges, but this varies by country.
faq.a4: Yes! You can cancel your subscription anytime through your account portal. You'll continue to receive boxes until the end of your current billing period.
faq.q5: What if my items arrive damaged?
faq.a5: We'll send a replacement at no cost. Just contact us within 14 days of delivery with photos of the damage.
faq.a6: We ship worldwide by default. However, some remote areas, special territories, or carrier-restricted regions may require availability confirmation before shipment. If delivery is not feasible, we'll contact you to offer an alternate address, delay the shipment, or issue a refund for the affected box.
faq.a7: Boxes ship in the first week of each month. Delivery typically takes 7–14 business days depending on your location.
faq.a8: Not yet, but we're working on it! Stay tuned.

shipping.title: Shipping & Customs
shipping.subtitle: Everything you need to know about delivery.
shipping.flatRateDesc: All subscriptions include worldwide shipping at a flat rate of $10/month. This is included in your $60 monthly total.
shipping.deliveryDesc: Boxes ship in the first week of each month. Standard delivery takes 7–14 business days. Tracking is provided for all shipments.
shipping.customsDesc: All shipments are sent DDU (Delivered Duty Unpaid). You may be responsible for any import duties, taxes, or customs charges levied by your country. Most packages valued under $50 clear customs without additional charges, but policies vary by country.
shipping.coverageDesc: We ship worldwide by default. However, some remote areas, special territories, or carrier-restricted regions may require availability confirmation before shipment. If we determine that delivery to your address is not feasible, we will contact you to offer: (1) an alternate delivery address, (2) a delay until service becomes available, or (3) a full refund for the affected shipment. This policy ensures you are never charged for a box we cannot deliver.
shipping.weightDesc: Standard box weight: up to 450g. Dimensions are optimized for international shipping.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using TOKI & TOMO, you agree to the following terms.
terms.subscriptionText: Your subscription renews monthly at $60 ($50 membership + $10 shipping). You can cancel anytime via the Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
terms.shippingText: We ship worldwide by default. Some remote areas, special territories, or carrier-restricted regions may require availability confirmation before shipment. If delivery is not feasible, we will contact you to offer an alternate address, delay, or refund for the affected shipment.
terms.liabilityText: TOKI & TOMO is not responsible for delays caused by carriers, customs processing, or force majeure events. We will make reasonable efforts to resolve any delivery issues.
terms.changesText: We may update these terms. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. Here's how we handle your data.
privacy.collectionText: Email, name, shipping address, payment information (processed by Stripe), style preferences, and usage analytics.
privacy.usageText: To fulfill your subscription, personalize your experience, send shipping notifications, and improve our service.
privacy.sharingText: We share data only with essential service providers: Stripe (payments), Resend (email), and our shipping partners. We never sell your data.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting us at privacy@tokitomo.com.

replacement.title: Replacement & Refund Policy
replacement.intro: We want you to love every box.
replacement.damagedText: If items arrive damaged, contact us within 14 days with photos. We'll send replacements at no charge.
replacement.missingText: If your box is missing items, let us know within 14 days. We'll ship the missing items or provide store credit.
replacement.refundsText: We don't offer refunds for boxes already shipped. If we cannot deliver to your address (see our shipping policy), we'll issue a full refund for the affected shipment.
replacement.cancelText: Cancel anytime through the Customer Portal. You'll receive all boxes through the end of your current billing period.

journal.sampleTitle: The Art of Letter Writing in Japan
